meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让关键计划在敲定前先经受多方挑刺与交叉质疑,变得更扎实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你制定关键计划时希望有人从对立角度帮你查漏补缺,而不是只收获附和。
copy.tagline_en: Toughen up your plan by running it past a hostile review team before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own important plans and want them to survive hostile scrutiny before being locked in.

howto.what: 它会先宣告“HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”,再组织 5 个互相敌对的审查角色对同一个方案交叉挑刺;只有经受住攻击的结论被保留,最后由专职规划者整合成正式计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“adversarial”“cross-critique”等关键词,或要求计划经受最严苛的对抗性交叉评审时,触发该流程。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 模式把这个方案过一遍。
say.note: 会先听到模式开启宣告,随后进入对抗评审。

say.text: 请用 adversarial 五人组交叉批判这份架构设计。
say.note: 五个角色互相攻击,撑过攻击的意见才保留。

say.text: 对这个重构计划做一次 cross-critique 对抗审查。
say.note: 专职规划者会把幸存结论写成正式计划。

howto.what_en: Claude starts by announcing "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!", then forms 5 mutually hostile reviewers who cross-critique the same plan. Only conclusions that survive the attacks are kept, and a dedicated planner turns them into the final plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a hyperplan, adversarial or cross-critique plan, or demand that a plan face the harshest adversarial cross-review.

say_en.text: Run this plan through hyperplan mode.
say_en.note: The mode announcement appears, then adversarial review begins.

say_en.text: Use the adversarial five-member team to cross-critique this architecture.
say_en.note: Members attack each other; only surviving points stay.

say_en.text: Give this refactoring plan an adversarial cross-critique review.
say_en.note: A dedicated planner then formalizes the survivors.
